digest.component_or_area: CI test suite (mirror tier) — cross-platform portability and network isolation
propositions: Four modules in src/rebar perform unconditional module-top import fcntl, blocking import rebar entirely on non-POSIX platforms (Windows); collection fails ModuleNotFoundError
fcntl imports in lock.py, git_locking.py, marker.py, and doctor_loops.py must be guarded with try/except ImportError->None pattern to match established codebase invariant and restore collectability

Python 3.14 Linux changed multiprocessing default start method fork to forkserver, which uses AF_UNIX local IPC sockets that are wrongly rejected by the overly broad socket.socket.connect network guard patching all address families
socket.socket.connect guard must be narrowed to block only AF_INET and AF_INET6, delegating AF_UNIX and other non-network families to the original connect to allow forkserver IPC

Structural AST-based linter gate scripts/check_fcntl_import_guard.py must enforce fcntl import guards going forward, recognizing try/except, platform conditionals, and function-local imports as legitimate patterns
